name: Vectis Castle
description: Documented hydrostatics from 2.50 to 8.40 m draft and six trim tables, with documented cargo floors and panels and an approximate reconstructed exterior. Upright-only 3D reference; geometry does not supply hydrostatics.

config.source: 001_GENERAL_ARRANGEMENT.pdf principal dimensions; outline is illustrative, not traced or validated

hatchSurfaceSource.qualification: Conservative planning footprints within hatch openings. 12.53 m is the documented opening elevation, used provisionally for cover-top placement; cover thickness and load limits are unverified. Forward taper represented conservatively by two rectangles. Stored tween-deck panels exclude x=17.1–23.4 m from Hatch 2. No approved exterior cargo height inferred.
hatchSurfaceSource.panelSeams: Schematic only: ten equal divisions of Hatch 2 and four of Hatch 1, following the apparent arrangement. Not dimensioned panel boundaries, manufacturer IDs, or a basis for allowable panel reactions.

config.fixedSource: 004_STABILITY_LOADING_MANUAL.pdf pp5,21,28. Lightship 3660 t (approximate); installed tween-deck panels 269.60 t. Machinery and cranes are not added separately to lightship.

deck.source: 004_STABILITY_LOADING_MANUAL.pdf PDF p30 (printed 8.5), Store Position 4; documented panel aggregate centres.
notes: Installed or stored onboard: panel mass stays 269.60 t. Storage position 4 changes panel LCG to 16.930 m and KG to 12.838 m. Existing cargo is not moved automatically.
Installed decks provide upper and lower areas for each hold. Stored decks provide two full-height holds. The stepped outlines and aft storage exclusion are retained.

resources.label: Constant-LCB cross curves
resources.description: Documented starboard ordinates; interpolate displacement and initial trim, allowing source constant-LCB trim changes during heel. No heeled draft or trim path is supplied.

config.referenceWaterDensitySource: Manual seawater convention, PDF page 7; no density rescaling.

messages: LCB and LCF at 5.80 m and 5.85 m were corrected to the manual, PDF page 52. Recheck calculations using these upright values, especially longitudinal balance and draft distribution. Original values and correction notes are retained in the table file.
The original trim reference rows agree with the manual. Expanded table coverage is not a permitted loading limit.
